# King of Salt Pools

> Salt water pool conversions and salt chlorination system installation in the Tampa Bay Area, Florida. Family owned and operated, licensed and insured (Lic. #CPC1459279), authorized Jandy installer, with 25 years of salt water pool experience.

## Contact
- Phone: (855) 520-POOL / +1 855 520 7665
- Email: kingofsaltpoolsfl@gmail.com
- Service area: Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Wesley Chapel, Brandon, Riverview, Land O' Lakes, New Tampa, Lutz, Largo, Palm Harbor, Valrico

## Services
- Converting traditional chlorine pools to salt water
- Installing and replacing salt chlorination systems (Jandy TruClear)
- Every new system includes a 3-year manufacturer warranty

## Equipment
- Jandy TruClear salt chlorinator — rated for pools up to 35,000 gallons, 3-year warranty

## Notes
- Salt water pools are still sanitized by chlorine; the chlorine is generated automatically from dissolved salt instead of added by hand.
